name: Trauma
overview: Scripture reveals that in the midst of trauma and brokenness, the Lord is a faithful shepherd and protector who provides comfort and deliverance to those who seek Him. The Psalms emphasize God's nearness to the brokenhearted and His sheltering presence under His wings, offering a refuge of truth and safety. Believers are encouraged to cry out to the Lord in their distress, trusting that He hears and saves them from their fears and troubles.
